# tests/test_title_case.py
# Adjust the import below so that it points to the module that contains `title_case`
from title_case import title_case   # pragma: no cover

import pytest


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Happy-path tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "original, expected",
    [
        ("hello world", "Hello World"),                         # simple, lower case
        ("hELLo wORld", "Hello World"),                         # mixed upper/lower
        ("hello   world", "Hello World"),                       # collapsed internal spaces
        ("  leading and trailing  ", "Leading And Trailing"),   # strip outer whitespace
        ("hello-world", "Hello-world"),                         # punctuation inside “word”
        ("mañana será otro día", "Mañana Será Otro Día"),       # non-ASCII / accents
    ],
)
def test_title_case_happy_path(original, expected):
    assert title_case(original) == expected


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Edge-case tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_title_case_empty_string():
    """Empty input stays empty."""
    assert title_case("") == ""


def test_title_case_only_spaces():
    """A string that is only whitespace becomes empty."""
    assert title_case("     ") == ""


def test_title_case_mixed_whitespace():
    """Tabs/newlines are treated as word separators, collapsed to a single space."""
    src = "hello\tworld\npython"
    assert title_case(src) == "Hello World Python"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Error-case tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_input", [None, 123, 12.34, ["hello", "world"]])
def test_title_case_non_string_raises_attribute_error(bad_input):
    """
    Passing a non-string value should fail because the object
    does not implement the .split() method used inside title_case.
    """
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        title_case(bad_input)   # type: ignore[arg-type]
